feature: owned fixed-route yield entries and fresh clear scans through measured relocalization
scope: Viewed authored straight-route simulation with surveyed circles and synchronous XY LiDAR; no held-out automotive, uncertainty, real-time or vehicle qualification.

contract.admission: stopped <=0.05 m/s, distance+radius+0.2 < half width, abs heading error <0.2 rad; every unowned/rearmed front margin >=0.5m
contract.ownership: retain previously committed entry only when measured front remains beyond its line; mark Passed only with owned entry and measured rear beyond exit; otherwise rearm Waiting; never infer permission from pose
contract.freshness: clear forecasts, clear dwell and all scan credit; acquisitions <=reset time cannot establish clear evidence; unfinished duties require a full new 1s clear dwell
contract.fault: invalid admission latches emergency braking and blocks signal passage, stop dwell, yield commitment despite later healthy observations
contract.composition: straight original surveyed route, including native chassis/local route geometry; explicit flags for stop/signal compositions
